title: Real Estate Microservice

_meta.purpose: Machine-readable PRD for the Real Estate Microservice (real-estate-portfolio) flat single-concern microservice foundation; metadata-only scope with explicit non-claims.

goals.scalability: Independent horizontal scaling per ADR-0348 (autosharding/auto-rebalance); tenant- and cell-scoped writes with no shared mutable global state. Foundation scope: metadata-only, no measured scaling evidence.
goals.security: Default-deny tenant isolation via Cedar (ADR-0243) and tenant-as-scope (ADR-0244); no raw credential/PII/secret bytes in the domain. Foundation scope: no runtime authentication.
goals.performance: Per-manifest SLO and capacity targets (ADR-0340) required before any GA claim; async-first eventing on Pulsar. Foundation scope: no measured SLO.
goals.efficiency: FinOps cost attribution (ADR-0344) and flat single-concern crates (ADR-0131/0132) that avoid platform bloat. Foundation scope: no runtime cost telemetry.
goals.reliability: Idempotent metadata operations and rollback-first promotion. Foundation scope: no DR drill evidence.

non_goals: No live SAP RE-FX backend, SAP Cloud for Real Estate, Oracle Lease Accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Asset leasing, workspace-management, property-tax, service-charge settlement, or lease-accounting engine integration.

No durable persistence, GL/AP/AR posting, payment execution, fixed-asset capitalization, plant-maintenance work-order creation, workspace reservation, team directory synchronization, document archive write, Workflow execution, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
No SAP RE-FX, Oracle, Microsoft, property-management, facility-management, IFRS 16, ASC 842, or local real-estate statutory compliance certification claim.

acceptance_criteria.given: a real-estate property/rental object has tenant, legal entity, business entity, building, rental-object, usage, area, capacity, validity, source ref, and audit evidence
acceptance_criteria.when: the real-estate domain registers the object metadata
acceptance_criteria.then: property, tenant, legal entity, business entity, building, rental object, type, usage, area, capacity, validity, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, schema version, and false architectural-view/RE-FX/fixed-asset/PM/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered property has lease contract metadata with party, direction, classification, term, rent, deposit, source ref, and audit evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: lease, property, tenant, legal entity, party, direction, classification, dates, term, rent, deposit, total nominal rent, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, schema version, and false lease-accounting/GL/AP-AR/document-archive/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered lease has payment frequency, period count, recurring payment, due dates, source ref, and audit evidence
acceptance_criteria.when: lease cash-flow projection metadata is prepared
acceptance_criteria.then: cash flow, lease, tenant, legal entity, frequency, period count, recurring payment, projected total, due dates, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, schema version, and false periodic-posting/payment/subledger/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered property/rental object has rentable-area, committed-area, requested-area, seats, team ref, occupancy dates, source ref, and audit evidence
acceptance_criteria.when: space occupancy plan metadata is prepared
acceptance_criteria.then: occupancy plan, property, rental object, tenant, legal entity, total/committed/requested/remaining area, seats, team ref, dates, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, schema version, and false workspace/team-sync/reservation/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered property/rental object has a maintenance asset ref, service priority, planned maintenance window, source ref, and audit evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: facility link, property, rental object, tenant, legal entity, maintenance asset ref, priority, window, source, evidence, idempotency key, state, schema version, and false PM-work-order/IoT/service-ticket/Workflow/cloud flags are present

acceptance_criteria.given: untrusted identifiers, team/asset/source/evidence refs, dates, areas, capacities, terms, amounts, period counts, windows, or overclaim paths enter the real-estate domain
acceptance_criteria.then: prefix-only identifiers, path traversal, whitespace/control characters, credential-shaped refs, invalid date ranges, invalid areas, capacity shortage, missing property registration, missing lease contract, zero amounts, invalid periods, invalid terms, and invalid maintenance windows are refused

decision_log.decision: Real Estate enters the enterprise microservice set as a flat portfolio domain crate rather than a monolithic ERP/RE-FX platform; SAP RE-FX parity is represented through Tenant RBAC composition while live RE-FX/cloud integrations, lease-accounting engines, GL/AP/AR/payment posting, PM work orders, workspace/team synchronization, document archives, Workflow execution, runtime audit emission, and cloud deployment remain explicit non-claims.
